sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the required ship-level iceSnowMitigationCoverage operand with an inclusive true constraint, applies route accessibility and safety checks to exposed escape routes, and requires the declared mitigation-evidence relationship and evidence artifact without duplicating route facts across owners.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The graph duplicates the route requirement with ship-level accessibleStatus, safeStatus, and iceSnowMitigationCoverage checks. Those ship-level booleans do not establish the required condition for every exposed escape route and impose an additional aggregate requirement.
